query:
SELECT 
  'interactions' as data_type,
  COUNT(*) as count
FROM contact_interactions ci
JOIN contacts c ON ci.contactId = c.id
JOIN users u ON c.parentUserId = u.id
WHERE u.name LIKE '%jiang%'
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'sharing_as_sharer' as data_type,
  COUNT(*) as count
FROM contact_sharing_connections csc
JOIN users u ON csc.sharerId = u.id
WHERE u.name LIKE '%jiang%'
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'sharing_as_receiver' as data_type,
  COUNT(*) as count
FROM contact_sharing_connections csc
JOIN users u ON csc.receiverId = u.id
WHERE u.name LIKE '%jiang%';
